lines.say: blood sugar falls in type 2 diabetes as insulin works better; alone it rarely gets too low
prediabetes (off-label): 31% fewer new diabetes cases than placebo; lifestyle cut 58%
smaller lean-mass gains from strength training in healthy adults 65+ (small trial)
kidney function checked, since metformin builds up when the kidneys are weak
boxed warning: lactic acidosis, a rare but sometimes fatal acid buildup
about 7% had low B12 in trials, which can cause anemia; B12 and blood count checked
diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, gas and stomach upset are common

ask: Is there a reason for me to take metformin if I don't have diabetes or prediabetes?
